title: OurHome Chore Event Points Awarded Leaderboard
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ourhome:chore points_awarded=*
| stats sum(points_awarded) as total_value, avg(points_awarded) as avg_value by child_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks child name values by total and average points awarded across OurHome chore event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `points_awarded` values for each OurHome chore event event and review total and average points awarded by child name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total points awarded.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which child name shows the biggest points awarded numbers in your OurHome chore event data.
